Coverage notes: All 1,372 Commonwealth bodies on the Department of Finance AGOR snapshot (departments, agencies, boards and other AGOR classifications). Landing page: https://data.gov.au/data/dataset/australian-government-organisations-register

Entities treated as GSF agencies under the Government Sector Finance Act 2018, including departments, statutory bodies, state-owned corporations, integrity agencies, universities and controlled entities. Treasury describes the list as indicative and not real-time. Guide: https://www.nsw.gov.au/departments-and-agencies/nsw-treasury/documents-library/gsf-agency-list-guide (publication date 31 March 2026; file is in a June 2026 folder).

Source name: VPSC list of public sector employers (19 October 2026)
Coverage notes: Victorian public sector employers (public service and public entities, including health services and TAFEs), with portfolio and body type. Not every public entity (non-employer bodies are out of scope). Live list: https://www.vpsc.vic.gov.au/about-public-sector/list-public-sector-employers

Administrative units listed in the Order (departments and a number of other units such as Queensland Health, Queensland Police Service, Public Sector Commission). Gazetted 3 July 2026; made 2 July 2026. This is not a full statutory-bodies register. PDF: https://www.qld.gov.au/__data/assets/pdf_file/0023/908411/administrative-arrangements-order-no.-1-2026.pdf

Agencies named on the official ministers-and-departments page (including some bodies that sit beside departments, e.g. Trade and Investment Queensland and Arts Queensland). Not a comprehensive register of all statutory bodies. Used to supplement the AAO administrative-units list; duplicates were removed.

Source name: WA Public Sector Commission government sector mailing list
Coverage notes: Public sector agencies (departments, SES and non-SES organisations) and Public Sector Management Act 1994 Schedule 1 entities, including public universities, government trading enterprises, local governments and other Schedule 1 bodies. Local governments are included because they appear in the source list; filter Entity type/classification to exclude them if not required. Page: https://www.wa.gov.au/government/publications/government-sector-mailing-list

Source name: SA 2026-27 Budget Statement, Appendix D – South Australian state public sector organisations
Coverage notes: Government-controlled entities grouped as general government, public non-financial corporations and public financial corporations, as at the 2026-27 Budget. Parsed from a two-column PDF layout. Budget page: https://www.treasury.sa.gov.au/budget/current-budget

Source name: Administrative units of the Public Service of South Australia
Coverage notes: Current public service administrative units (departments and attached offices) only. The PDF's historical/abolished units section was excluded. Entities already listed in Budget Appendix D were deduplicated, preferring Appendix D as the source. Index: https://www.legislation.sa.gov.au/lists-and-index-to-sa-legislation/administrative-units

Source name: Financial Management Act 2016, Schedule 1 – General Government Sector Agencies
Coverage notes: Statutory general government sector agencies in Schedule 1 Part 1 (government agencies) and Part 2 (legislative agencies), current as at the last applied amendment (No. 30 of 2025, 8 October 2026).

Source name: Tasmanian State Service Careers – Our agencies
Coverage notes: Named State Service departments and state authorities on the careers 'Our agencies' page. Used because the DPAC 'About the Tasmanian State Service' page (https://www.dpac.tas.gov.au/working-in-the-state-service/about-the-tasmanian-state-service, modified 10 November 2026) states there are 18 agencies (nine departments and nine state authorities) but does not name them. Entities already in FMA Schedule 1 were deduplicated, preferring the FMA as the source. The page names 17 agencies (plus Service Tasmania, which was treated as a service brand and omitted).

Eight directorates, listed public sector bodies and statutory authorities, and Icon Water (territory-owned corporation). The ACT Directory (directory.act.gov.au) was not used because that site warns it still reflects pre-1 July 2025 structures.

Source name: Administrative Arrangements Order 2026, Schedule 1 – Nomination of Agencies
Coverage notes: Agencies nominated in Schedule 1: Part 1 (Financial Management Act and Public Sector Employment and Management Act), Part 2 (Financial Management Act only) and Part 3 (Public Sector Employment and Management Act only). Made 27 May 2026; commenced and gazetted S41 on 1 June 2026. Does not attempt to list every non-agency body mentioned in Schedule 2.
